content: Vedant Thakur followed up regarding his reinstated auto policy (#AV-45231) to inquire about the next renewal date (which is September 15, 2027) and whether he could lower his deductible to $250 immediately. Neha Kapoor confirmed that the deductible can be changed at any time and offered to update it upon request, while also providing the updated policy document attachment.

action_items: Customer to decide if they want to proceed with lowering the deductible to $250
Agent to send a revised quote if the customer requests the deductible change
